mapper.select:
/* 수출수입심사현황 - 오류건 (4040) */ /* RevertStatErrorMapper.selectList */
SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT_STR
, A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD = '60' THEN '재스캔' WHEN A.B_AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '40' THEN '재추출' ELSE '수기' END AS ERR_TXT , A.ACTL_FX_REFNO , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , A.FC_CUNM , A.AI_INPT_BUY_AM , A.CSNO , A.AI_INPT_CUS_NM , A.AI_INSPE_ENO , A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO , A.AI_INSPE_ENM , A.AI_APPV_ENM , A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM , A.INPT_ATVTNM , A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD FROM VW_TASK A
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATVTNM
ORDER BY A.INPT_ATVTNM DESC
ORDER BY A.FC_CUNM
ORDER BY A.FC_CUNM DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_BUY_AM
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_BUY_AM DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
